components.name: API Client
components.purpose: Sends authenticated requests to protected APIs.

components.name: API Gateway
components.purpose: Applies tenant/principal identity and asks for a budget decision.

components.name: Limiter Service
components.purpose: Computes allow/deny decisions using an atomic state transition.

components.name: Bucket Store
components.purpose: Holds atomic, expiring bucket state; Redis is one possible implementation.

components.name: Policy Service
components.purpose: Owns policy validation, versions and rollout.

components.name: Policy Database
components.purpose: Durable policy records and change history.

components.name: Policy Cache
components.purpose: Caches bounded, versioned policies near enforcement.

components.name: Protected API
components.purpose: Receives allowed requests only; handles dependency errors separately from quota denials.

components.name: Metrics Collector
components.purpose: Aggregates low-cardinality decision and latency counters without private keys.

tradeoffs.guidance: Define burst and error semantics; do not require all algorithms.
The latter needs a quantified global overshoot budget.
A timeout is an operational error, not proof that the client exhausted a quota.

dataModel.notes: Audit changes and define migration of old balances.
Example token-bucket state; transition atomically with bounded expiry.
Version ownership changes to avoid two independent full budgets.

flows.name: Decision
steps: Gateway derives a bounded key from authenticated identity and a canonical policy
Limiter reads a cached policy version
State owner atomically refills, checks and consumes budget
Return allow or deny with a calculated retry delay
Gateway forwards allowed requests and records a bounded decision metric

flows.name: Policy rollout
steps: Validate and store a new policy version
Distribute or refresh cached policy versions
Migrate existing bucket balances under the documented rule
